A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AUDSEMTHINKER/AUDSEM work and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and appendices. Relocated acknowledgements and renumbered appendices can be matched reliably.

before.justification: v1 reports original model evaluations on MMAU and AudioBench, training ablations, and thinking-budget experiments in Tables 3–6.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds a three-annotator evaluation of 100 AUDSEM examples in Section 3.

M1.justification: The dataset-generation pipeline, Qwen2.5-Omni backbone, semantic reasoning format, SFT/GRPO procedures, LoRA adaptation, and reward functions are unchanged. The human audit evaluates the existing dataset.

E1.justification: AUDSEM's four task types, MMAU, and the AudioBench task subsets are retained. The human audit samples existing AUDSEM examples without extending the represented data, domains, or task coverage.

E2.justification: Table 3 adds Gemini 2.0 Flash and Gemini 2.5 Flash to the MMAU comparison, using externally reported results. Existing MMAU comparators and the AudioBench comparator set remain unchanged.

E3.justification: Section 3 introduces a human-evaluation protocol: 100 randomly selected examples, three annotators, and 1–5 Likert ratings for correctness and response depth. Existing training settings, benchmark splits, metrics, and evaluation procedures remain unchanged.

E4.justification: v2 adds a supplementary human audit testing whether AUDSEM captions accurately describe the audio and provide sufficient depth. The semantic-descriptor, LoRA, dataset-composition, and thinking-budget analyses are retained unchanged.

E5.justification: The human audit introduces inter-rater reliability reporting: correctness alpha 0.538, ICC(2,1) 0.589, linearly weighted kappa 0.464–0.529, and depth alpha 0.207. Benchmark uncertainty reporting and existing run-count information are unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 3 adds Gemini 2.0 Flash averages of 55.60/59.93 on Test-Mini/Test and Gemini 2.5 Flash's 67.18 on Test-Mini, exceeding the retained 66.70 for AUDSEMTHINKER-QA GRPO. Section 3 adds 70–77% highest-score correctness ratings and over 85% highest-score depth ratings. Existing model and ablation scores are unchanged.

T1.justification: The piecewise length reward and its clipping-threshold derivations, Equations 1–7, are unchanged. The thinking-budget appendix moves from Appendix D to C; no new formal definitions or proofs are introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims about semantic reasoning, dataset quality, reduced contamination, and performance. The additional evidence does not alter their stated scope.

C2.justification: Explanations of SFT versus GRPO, music-versus-speech performance, semantic-descriptor effects, and reward clipping remain unchanged, as do contamination and hardware-related qualifications. The human-audit addition reports rating findings without developing a new mechanism explanation or applicability boundary.

D1.justification: Implementation details, preprocessing instructions, hyperparameters, hardware, training times, prompts, and code/data access statements are retained. The detailed pipeline and prompt appendices are renumbered without substantive changes.

R1.justification: v2 adds references for Gemini 1.5, Gemini 2.0, Gemini 2.5, and GAMA. Gemini 1.5 and GAMA were already listed as baselines in v1. The related-work discussion and broader novelty positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: Acknowledgements move from Appendix A to Section 7, shifting subsequent appendix labels. Section 3 gains the short human-audit paragraph, and bibliography formatting is edited. Most prose and the scientific narrative are retained.

P2.justification: Table 3 gains two baseline rows and moves from page 7 to page 8. Table 6 moves from page 19 to page 18, with accompanying text and figure reflow. Existing figures retain their content and design.

improvement.justification: v2 adds direct human evidence for caption quality alongside v1's automated checks and broadens the MMAU comparison. These are useful but limited gains: the audit covers 100 examples and has low depth agreement, while the unchanged performance discussion does not address Gemini 2.5 Flash's higher Test-Mini average.
